findings.finding: Q3 is the first runway statement after both the NOK 286m placement and the adverse tax ruling; on the company's own numbers it should land around 'into 2029' without the refund, which is roughly what the placement release implied net of the tax refund, so the statement is new but its sign against expectations cannot be called.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Runway restatements have come with prints that moved -9.8% (Q2 2025, strategy reset), +3.6% (Q3 2025) and -0.9% (Q2 2026); never isolated from other news.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the market cap at 2.685 NOK x 391.5m shares is about NOK 1.05bn against an estimated ~USD 65m of cash, so the market already discounts the runway heavily; the dated runway figure itself has not been published since the ruling ('cash runway beyond key value inflection points' was undated). If the market had a number, the sell-off since 25 Sep would not have continued without news.

findings.finding: The Q3 accounts must reflect the 25 Sep Tax Appeal Board ruling against Nykode on the NOK 325m (~USD 34m) tax already paid and carried as 'Other non-current receivables' (USD 33.4m at 30 June), so a large non-cash charge or a disclosed decision to keep the receivable pending reconsideration is due.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ruling itself moved the stock -7.6% on the next session (3.905 to 3.61, 25 to 28 Sep, Yahoo tape); the accounting echo has no precedent on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the ruling and its amount were inside information on 25 Sep and the company said no further payment follows. Only a headline net-loss figure of roughly USD 40m could mislead a screen-reader; the lesson that a known number is worth 0 holds it near zero.
findings.independence: Q2 report balance-sheet note on Other non-current receivables of USD 33.4m (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680771).

findings.finding: Nykode's own release boilerplate changed between 23 Oct and 5 Nov from 'dedicated to the discovery and development of novel immunotherapies' to 'dedicated to the discovery and development of cancer vaccines', which may foreshadow a refocus (and lower spend on the tolerance platform) announced with Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August 2025 strategy reset came with the Q2 2025 report, which moved -9.8%; a cost refocus at this cash level would more likely read as runway-positive.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference from wording only; no press or forum item picked it up, and the 'About' paragraph still names the tolerance platform, so it may be nothing. If the market expected a refocus, the stock would not be making new lows into the print.
